subject: Control-lineage matrix and evidence kanban for CAIQ closure
messages:
From: Sara Dalton <sara.dalton@bluefronthealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluefronthealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ - control lineage and evidence index request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our security review we need a concise control-lineage artifact that ties Redwood's CAIQ assertions back to specific runtime evidence and owners. Procurement is asking for two deliverables by next Wednesday: 1) a matrix that maps CAIQ questions -> Redwood control assertions -> evidence artifact (log samples, runbooks, attestation screenshots) and 2) a lightweight kanban-style index (by control owner) so our audit team can pull attachments during the review.

Can you confirm you can deliver a draft by 2027-04-12 EOD PST and indicate ownership for items that require engineering access? If there are gaps we'll need a short remediation plan and expected ship date.

Attachments we expect to reference: sample log exports, auth rotation records, and any SOC 2 attestation snippets.

Best,
Sara Dalton
Security Manager
BlueFront Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dalton <sara.dalton@bluefronthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - control lineage and evidence index request

Sara — thanks, we can do this. High level plan:

- Deliverable 1: Control-lineage matrix (CAIQ question -> Redwood assertion -> evidence pointer + timestamp/sample) — Jordan will own the mapping and initial population.
- Deliverable 2: Evidence kanban (by control owner, status: needs-collection / in-review / uploaded) — Marissa will create the board and coordinate owners.

We will include a minimal remediation plan for any gaps (owner, ETA, blocker). Kimberly will surface any buckets that require privileged access or engineering pull.

Timeline: Draft matrix + kanban by 2027-04-12 17:00 PST; final package (signed attestation snippets) by 2027-04-16 if no major gaps.

I'll attach the first-pass artifacts to the next message (matrix spreadsheet + kanban PDF).

—Jordan
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Forwarding the draft artifacts per Jordan's plan. See attachments: caiq_control-lineage-matrix.xlsx (tabbed: CAIQ_question, assertion, evidence_pointer, owner, sample_timestamp), evidence-kanban-board.pdf (columns: needs-collection | in-review | uploaded | blocked) and a small auth-rotation-log-sample.txt stub to demonstrate format.

- Controls related to key management (KMS rotations) have full logs attached but need owner attestation for HSM policy (Kimberly to confirm).
- Runtime telemetry samples for prefix/KV cache are present but redacted; engineering needs to sign off on extraction for auditor access (we flagged as 'in-review' on Kanban).
- A few CAIQ items mapped to 'compensating control narrative' rather than direct artifact; we included a short proposed narrative in the matrix and marked those cards 'in-review'.

Action items: 
1) Kimberly — confirm HSM/KMS attestation text and move those cards to 'uploaded' if OK (ETA 2027-04-12 12:00 PST).
2) Jordan/Eng — sign off on telemetry extraction examples (comment on Kanban card) by 2027-04-12 15:00 PST.
3) Marissa — consolidate final zip for procurement when cards are 'uploaded'.

Attachments: caiq_control-lineage-matrix.xlsx (attached), evidence-kanban-board.pdf (attached), auth-rotation-log-sample.txt (attached)

Thanks — I'll be standing by for the confirmations.

—Marissa
